failure_pattern.bottom_then_top: all BT families failed during the initial BOTTOM phase at phase step 7
failure_pattern.top_then_bottom_n10: TOP phase completed, then BOTTOM failed at phase step 3
failure_pattern.top_then_bottom_n11_n12: TOP phase itself failed at step 11 before the BOTTOM phase

interpretation: Temporal top/bottom separation can create substantially larger vertical-distribution shifts than the E03 simultaneous-throughflow route while preserving total profile water to roundoff.

The accepted TB_N08 and TB_N09 endpoints remain far below the BASE_EQ upper-30-cm storage, by about 0.0564 and 0.0595 cm respectively, so they do not isolate deeper-profile memory at fixed root30 storage.

The bottom-only -K0 phase is the numerical admissibility bottleneck: all BOTTOM_THEN_TOP families fail at its seventh interval, and TB_N10 fails at the third bottom interval after a completed ten-step TOP phase.

This failure pattern supports a new prospective rate discriminator using the same integrated bottom transfer spread over smaller bottom flux and more intervals; it does not justify threshold relaxation.
nonclaims: E03B does not establish H_c plus W_profile plus W_root30 sufficiency.
E03B does not falsify deeper-profile memory.
No production coupling change is admitted.
